formats.notes: Frameworks and 'N rules' decks, 6-9 slides: the cover (count in the kicker, one oversized serif word, the deck's own interiors fanned below), then one rule per slide alternating a photo page (a text-free Codex photo plate, the rule's metaphor as one lone object) and a quiet photocopy-grey text page (no plate), then a quiet CTA with the keyword as the giant serif word. Each rule page is spine C's item: numeral badge, a headline of 7 words or fewer, and about 40 words saying what to do, why, and one concrete use; proof, when a rule needs it, is one capture card on a quiet page. Also fits the C-variant findings listicle (rules drawn from a real corpus). Not for tool roundups (no logo or capture vocabulary on photo pages), head-to-heads or step-by-step builds. Cooldown group photo-editorial with S15.

attributes.ground: Cinematic film-photo environments (sea, lake, tall grass, salt flat, fog) with heavy grain, one lone object as the rule's metaphor; quiet pages are photocopy grey #CFCDC8 with toner grain and streaks
attributes.type_pairing: One oversized Instrument Serif word (grown to the full 872 px measure) between an Inter 800 kicker and trailing line; Inter 700 rule headlines and Inter 500 body at tight tracking; white-on-ink numeral badges; JetBrains Mono masthead
attributes.panel: Fanned preview cards of the deck's own rendered interiors on the cover; interiors alternate a photo page with a quiet grainy text page
attributes.character: None (one lone object or an anonymous figure from behind)
attributes.ornament: Mono masthead row (month ©year · {{BRAND}} · role), numeral badge per rule, warm orange light-leak gradient at the cover's foot, a three-phrase row under the fan
attributes.palette: Photo-native slate, grey-blue, straw and sage; ink #0E0E0E or white type chosen by sky-tone; orange #D9551F only as the cover's warm leak, one touch on a subject and the CTA keyword

exemplars.note: Sample renders from the kit (cover and photo page, placeholder topic, brand shown as YOUR BRAND) over two sample Codex plates. No posted deck in this style yet.

requires: Overlay kit engine/styles/kits/S13/ (README): cards/s13.css + s13.js, slide-01 cover, slide-02 photo page, slide-03 quiet page, slide-04 CTA, each with a slide-data JSON block {layout, box}; copied to $D/cards/slide-NN.html ({{BRAND}} filled in) and rendered with node shared/render-card.mjs at 1080x1350 --scale 1 --min-px 22

One text-free Codex photo plate per photo page plus the cover (SYSTEM + the layout's Plate line; shared/codex-img.mjs), fitted with python -I shared/composite.py plates/slide-NN.png fitted/slide-NN.png. Quiet pages and the CTA have none, so a 7-slide deck needs about 4 plates. Refs: none for your first plate (text-only prompt); after that your deck's own approved photo plate (engine/styles/refs/s13-ref-photo.png, a sample plate, until then); never anyone else's slide
Tone pass: node shared/sky-tone.mjs $D picks ink or white per page from the card's box and stamps <body>; exit 4 means the calm zone is busy: edit the plate
The cover renders last: its three fan cards are the deck's own exports
Fonts: Instrument Serif, Inter 500/700/800, JetBrains Mono 700 (Google Fonts)
Originality: never copy any reference deck's subjects, handle, role line, words, hook or CTA phrasing; the cover fan shows only your own slides

styles.name: Scenic Painterly
styles.one_line: A painted landscape per slide, cream Didone, paper list card, optionally your own mascot doing a different activity each slide.

formats.notes: Collections and big lists grouped by job, 6-9 slides: a golden-hour cover (the count as a giant orange numeral, a capture of the full list, an optional cover pose), one item-group slide per job (a painted landscape, the job as a Didone headline, a paper list card of up to 6 items, an optional activity pose), an optional proof slide for the 1-2 strongest items, and a dusk CTA. Grouping is a declared deviation from spine C's one-item slides: log 'item slides group up to 6 items by job' in deviations[]. Every row still carries spine C's item contract in small form: the exact name, a what-it-does line of 8 words or fewer and one figure verified on posting day; a card of bare names fails G4. Not for single-item explainers, head-to-heads or builds.

attributes.ground: A new hand-painted gouache-and-oil landscape per slide (meadow, river bank, hills, sea cliff, forest edge): a calm sky band over 0-34%, plain distant scenery behind the card, a foreground meadow (with a clear spot for a mascot, if you use one). Light arc: golden-hour cover, morning to sunset items, dusk CTA
attributes.type_pairing: Playfair Display 800/900 Didone headlines with one orange line or word, cream #F5EBE0 on deep skies and warm ink #2A1E16 on bright ones (sky-tone decides); Inter list rows; JetBrains Mono header, labels, figures and footer
attributes.panel: A cream paper list card (HTML) floating over the middle distance; a tilted cream-bordered capture window on the cover and proof slides
attributes.character: Optional: your own mascot (never a licensed character) doing a different activity each slide, a transparent PNG pose pasted on the plate's clear spot over a painted-ground shadow, never painted, never repeated. With none, the plate's one small orange object stands alone
attributes.ornament: Small mono header row with an outlined NN / TT box, a mono footer mantra repeated on every slide
attributes.palette: Painted greens #5E8F2E / #8DB04A, warm earth #C9A46A, the layout's sky; cream #F5EBE0, paper #F4ECDD, orange #D9551F on the accent line, the numeral and one small object per plate

exemplars.note: Sample renders from the kit (cover and item group, no mascot, placeholder figures and a dashed capture stand-in) over two sample Codex plates. No posted deck in this style yet.

requires: Overlay kit engine/styles/kits/S14/ (README): cards/s14.css + s14.js, slide-01 cover, slide-02 item group, slide-03 CTA, each with a slide-data JSON block {layout, box}; copied to $D/cards/slide-NN.html and rendered with node shared/render-card.mjs at 1080x1350 --scale 1 --min-px 22. The list check fails the render past 6 rows, or when a row lacks its what line or figure

One text-free Codex landscape plate per slide (SYSTEM + the layout's Plate line; shared/codex-img.mjs; .png references only), Image 1 always engine/styles/refs/s14-ref-item.png (an approved sample plate: brushwork and light only), Image 2 the deck's first approved plate once there is one; fitted with python -I shared/composite.py plates/slide-NN.png fitted/slide-NN.png
Tone pass: node shared/sky-tone.mjs $D with each card's box; exit 4 means a busy sky: edit the plate

Optional mascot: your own transparent PNG poses (never a licensed character), one activity per slide, never repeated, placed on the plate's clear spot from $D/mascot/; cut new ones with python -I shared/pose-check.py cut. With no mascot, drop the Spot sentence from the plate prompts
Verified data per row (stars, installs or another figure) pulled on posting day and saved in the deck; a real capture of the full list for the cover (shots.py)
Fonts: Playfair Display 800/900, Inter 500/600/700, JetBrains Mono 700 (Google Fonts)

styles.name: Landscape Specimen
styles.one_line: A cinematic landscape per item, the name set giant in the sky as a two-font specimen, masthead row, BACK/NEXT nav.

formats.notes: Top-N tools, plugins, repos and 'best X + Y pairings' listicles, one item per landscape. Every item slide carries spine C's full item contract in about 30 words: the name, a caption on what it does and what it replaces, a mono use line with one concrete use, and a proof line verified on posting day. Proof slides add one real capture on the horizon. Not for head-to-heads (no table vocabulary) or how-it-works explainers. Shares a 14-day cooldown with S13 (cooldown_group photo-editorial) and with S14/S28 (landscape-grounds); build-gallery shows both.

attributes.ground: A different full-bleed cinematic landscape photo per slide (wheat field, grassy hill, canola field, dune, night field): open sky above 44% of the height, horizon at 56-72%, fine film grain. Golden-hour cover, day and deep-blue items, dusk, night CTA
attributes.type_pairing: A font-pairing 'specimen' stack set in the sky: a quiet kicker face (Didone italic, roman serif or grotesk) over a giant loud face (Inter Black, Archivo black condensed italic or Archivo extended black), chosen by the name's length. Below it a small semibold grotesk caption, then mono use and proof lines. Mono numerals in the nav
attributes.panel: None on plain item slides. Proof slides float one cream-bordered, focus-cropped real capture on the horizon. The cover's monitor screen is a magenta-keyed real capture. Every word is an HTML overlay on a text-free plate
attributes.character: Cover: a close, low-angle field desk whose monitor (at least 45% of the width) shows a real capture, beside an orange folding chair; you appear only from your own photos, if you opt in. Interiors: one small lone subject per landscape as the item's metaphor, carrying one orange touch. Optional: your own mascot as an overlay sprite (never a licensed character)
attributes.ornament: A two-column masthead ({{BRAND}} | deck label · month), a BACK <-> NEXT rule with a numbered progress row (the current number in an orange pill), and mono use and proof lines
attributes.palette: Photo-native skies (#8FB6D9 day blue, #1F5FA8 deep blue, #F3E3C8 golden hour, #1E2F52 over #E9A15A dusk, #0F1B33 night navy) and fields (#E8D320 canola, #D8B45A wheat). Type is ink #0E0E0E or white, whichever has the higher WCAG contrast. Orange #D9551F only on the subject and the nav pill. No magenta, violet or pink, and no cyan or turquoise outside key zones

exemplars.note: Sample renders from templates/06-landscape-specimen (cover and item, brand shown as YOUR BRAND) over S13's sample Codex photo plates used as stand-ins. No posted deck in this style yet.

requires: HTML overlay kit: templates/06-landscape-specimen/overlay.html, copied per slide to cards/slide-NN.html ({{BRAND}} filled in) and rendered over the fitted plate with node shared/render-card.mjs at 1080x1350 --scale 1 (recipe.md). It holds the masthead, the specimen stack (P1-P3, cover set, name-length fit pass), caption, use and proof lines, capture card, combo icons and BACK/NEXT nav; tone arrives as <body> data attributes. Exit 2 means a copy rewrite

Tone pass: node shared/sky-tone.mjs carousels/<id> samples the masthead, stack and nav regions of fitted/slide-NN.png, picks ink or white by WCAG contrast, adds a 20/35/50% scrim when a region falls short, writes runs/tone/slide-NN.json and stamps each card's <body>. Exit 4 means a region is still short at 50%: edit the plate for a calmer sky

Plate aspect normalisation: every plate, keyed or not, goes through python -I shared/composite.py plates/slide-NN.png fitted/slide-NN.png (centre crop + Lanczos to 1080x1350) before the tone pass and overlay, so keyed and unkeyed slides crop the same way

One text-free Codex landscape plate per slide (shared/codex-img.mjs): a new terrain per item, a lone subject with one orange touch. No style refs ship: the first plates run on the text prompt alone, then lock grain, lens and haze (not the grade) with one approved plate per time of day (golden, day, dusk, night) and attach the nearest; never anyone else's slide

Cover: a close, low-angle field desk at 55-80% of the width with a magenta-keyed monitor screen at least 45% of the width (a real capture via composite.py --shot). A person appears only from 2-3 photos of yourself that you supply and opt into; no one else's likeness, no licensed IP

Proof for every item, verified on posting day (stars, price, licence), plus a concrete use line. Each proof slide and the cover monitor need one real capture, pre-cropped with shared/shots.py around a focus box so its key text is at least 1/45 of the slide height
Real app-icon PNGs for combo slides (your logo folder or simple-icons); never generated marks
Google Fonts: Playfair Display (italic 400 and 900), Instrument Serif, Archivo (variable wdth 62-125, with italics), Inter, JetBrains Mono

styles.name: Neon Node Pipeline
styles.one_line: Pure black, glowing numbered icon-node pipelines, one colour per concept; the listicle cover is a grid of every diagram.

formats.notes: C first ('N agent patterns', 'N ways X is built', 'how N tools work inside'): an overview-grid cover, then one pipeline per item (3-6 items; six colours, so six at most), each in its own colour with a proof chip. D: system cover, then the inspector rail in build-up states so the system visibly grows. A: system cover; what and model as explain pipelines, why as compare, how/peak/use/start as inspector slides. A and D are all Claude orange. Not for head-to-heads: a pipeline explains, it doesn't prove.

attributes.ground: Flat pure black #000000; one faint radial haze in the slide's colour behind the branch section only
attributes.type_pairing: Glowing Inter ExtraBold name in the concept colour over a plain-gloss line in Inter Medium; Inter SemiBold node labels with a black halo; JetBrains Mono tags, sub-labels, footer and counter
attributes.panel: Numbered vertical pipeline (4 rows or fewer with a proof band, 5 without): circle step nodes, diamond decision nodes, tool nodes holding real white logos; branch, merge and loop. Every item slide carries a proof chip with one real capture; build steps turn the pipeline into a horizontal rail over an inspector panel holding one real capture or exact-text card
attributes.character: None by default; optional: your own mascot (transparent PNG poses you made, never a licensed character) on clear black beside the CTA output node, only when the pose comments
attributes.ornament: Beaded glowing connectors on the path taken, faint dashed ghost paths, number badges tinted per colour (cream on orange), Claude-orange hairline under the cover headline
attributes.palette: Black / near-white / Claude orange #D9551F for the hero item (and the whole deck on spines A and D) + white (dark-grey nodes), amber, lime, green, cobalt, one per item on spine C; no purple, pink, teal or cyan (keying-safe)

exemplars.note: Sample renders from templates/05-node-pipeline's own sample slides (a Claude Code /command explainer with public docs captures): the system cover and a proof pipeline. No posted deck in this style yet.

requires: Template: templates/05-node-pipeline renders each slide's graph JSON (circle, diamond and tool nodes, tinted badges, Lucide icons, beaded, ghost and loop connectors, branch haze, caption, proof band, inspector panel, overview grid, system cover) and bakes with node shared/export.mjs --carousel <id>; recipe.md has the layouts and fields. Its fit pass throws (exit 1, slide and rule named) on any copy cap or overflow

Each storyboard slide carries a graph (rows of node ids + nodes[] + edges[] + loop, the form recipe.md shows), pasted into slides[] verbatim. Feed node labels to the cold reader via slides[].evidence.describe
The cover-overview layout renders the item slides' own graphs at about 36%, so cover thumbnails match the interiors exactly and the usual cover-first order holds
Lucide (ISC) is vendored in shared/vendor/lucide/ and the template inlines the glyphs it uses: generic glyphs only. Never reuse a reference deck's node-to-icon pairings or drawings

White tool-node logos (#F5F5F5) in the deck's assets/ as <name>-white.png: claude-white.png ships with the template; make others from your logo folder or simple-icons, never drawn. Dark marks vanish on the #111111 face, teal, cyan and purple marks are banned hues, and an orange mark goes only on a non-orange slide

Every pipeline EXPLAINs: node names, order and branches checked against the real docs or repo. Every listicle item, why, how, use, build-step and payoff slide also PROVEs it with one real capture (proof chip, compare chip, inspector panel or use zone)

Originality: never copy any reference deck's topic, node names, node-to-icon pairings, words, art or signature palette; only the layout vocabulary carries over. Concept colours stay Claude orange, white, amber, lime, green and cobalt; the cover glow is white and the hairline Claude orange
Shares a 14-day cover cooldown with S07 Dark Network Hero (cooldown_group black-and-glow); build-gallery shows it

Optional image-native fallback (prompt block), only if the template can't carry a slide: Codex paints every plate, titles, node labels, badges and captions included (7 nodes or fewer, labels of 2 words or fewer); HTML cards carry only exact text (inspector prompts, commands, config); captures and logos are composited; the cover grid is composited from interior crops; Claude checks every label and badge number against strings[]. No refs ship: the first plates run text-only until the user's first approved plate becomes the reference

styles.name: Split-Band Before/After
styles.one_line: Cream-over-white split on every slide, mono 'Before:' / 'After:' labels, huge bold grotesk statements, one orange text-selection highlight.

formats.notes: C only. `cover`: the native S17 cover; its count line carries the count plus a month stamp or a verified star figure. `why` (optional): a Flip, or Twin proof when the old way can be proved too. Every `item` and `combo`: Flip + proof. The before statement is the habit the item replaced, the after statement names the item in one line, and the strip is real proof verified on posting day, so the slide gives what it does, what it replaces, proof and use. If the cold reader (G8) can't recover the item from that, use another style. `cta`: the CTA flip. Log two deviations in storyboard.deviations[]: (1) flips carry no accent phrase, because the mirror replaces it; (2) a pure-flip opinion list waives spine C's item proof. Unproven items drift toward a list of names with no proof, so that deck must still pass G8. Not A (no layout for what, model, peak or use), not B (two tools side by side is S03's job), not D. Suits opinionated takes on how AI changed a job: the format draws arguments and shares.

attributes.ground: Two flat full-bleed bands split at half height: warm cream (#F5EBE0) over white. Between them is a 7 px seam of barely darker cream (#EFE4D7, ΔE about 2.7), a soft step rather than a ruled line. No texture or grid.
attributes.type_pairing: Big bold neo-grotesk statements (Inter Display at about 650, sentence case, tight tracking and leading) plus regular mono labels ending in a colon (JetBrains Mono at 62 px). Two weights only, including the byline and the CTA lines.
attributes.panel: None on Flip slides. Flip + proof, mandatory on spine C items, puts one real 908×220 capture strip (about 4.1:1, square corners, 2 px ink outline) or one exact command chip in the after band. Twin proof adds a matching strip to the before band.
attributes.character: None. The system is pure type.
attributes.ornament: An editor text-selection box on the cover phrases and the CTA keyword: apricot fill multiplied over the band, orange edge bars, two handle dots, deep-brown selected text. Rounded real app-icon tiles on the cover (white, ink or the brand's own tile). A '{{BRAND}}' byline with your circle-cropped profile photo (optional). A small warm-grey mono counter.
attributes.palette: Cream #F5EBE0 / seam #EFE4D7 / white / ink #0E0E0E / Claude orange #D9551F on apricot #F8CFA8 (about #EEBF94 over cream) / selected text #3A1808 / counter grey #6B635B

exemplars.note: Sample renders from templates/07-split-band's own sample slides (blank tiles, placeholder avatar, YOUR BRAND byline): the cover and a Flip + proof slide with a command chip. No posted deck in this style yet.

requires: Template: templates/07-split-band: bands and seam, mono labels, statement fit pass (126 to 96 px floor) with the Copy limits, selection span, tile row, byline, proof strip, command chip, counter, CTA. Copy slides.html into the deck with {{BRAND}} filled in; bake with node shared/export.mjs --carousel <id>, which exits 3 on a FIT/COPY failure

Codex style refs, only for the plate fallback: engine/styles/refs/s17-style-cover.png and s17-style-flip.png, layout mocks in this style's own colours rendered from engine/styles/refs/src/s17-ref-cover.html and s17-ref-flip.html (off-topic placeholder copy); copy both into <deck>/refs/. Never another creator's slides

One tile PNG per cover tile at <deck>/assets/<x>-tile.png (template) or <deck>/logos/<x>-tile.png (plate fallback), only tools the deck covers (0–1 before, 1–5 after, in item order): the brand's press-kit app icon, or a simple-icons mark at 70% on a white or ink 80 px tile (radius 18 px) rendered with transparent corners via `node shared/render-card.mjs <card> <png> --w 80 --h 80 --scale 4`. Never painted

Optional byline photo: your square profile photo, circle-cropped with transparent corners, at <deck>/assets/avatar.png (template) or <deck>/logos/avatar.png (composite.py --logo trims to alpha and contain-fits; a square photo would paste as a square in the cyan circle). Without one, the template shows a plain grey circle

Mirrored-pair copy per the prompt block's Copy section: one label pair per deck; statements ≤ 7 words (G4), ≤ 3 lines of ≈ 15 characters; proof-slide after statements one line of ≤ 15; cover lines ≤ 13; CTA deliverable lines ≤ 24. Log the flips' missing accent phrase in storyboard.deviations[]

Proof for every spine C item: a real capture (README, UI or a real run, verified on posting day) cropped to 908 × 220 (≈ 4.1:1) with shared/shots.py focus boxes, or an exact one-line command of ≤ 34 characters. Decks needing large screenshots belong in another style

Originality: never copy any reference deck's words, statements, cover phrase, tool row, marks, creator name or photo, item set or signature palette; only the layout vocabulary carries over. No 'before/after {tool}' cover phrase; cover tiles only the deck's tools. Palette: cream #F5EBE0 top band; selection Claude orange on apricot #F8CFA8; selected text #3A1808

styles.name: Folder-Tab Field Guide
styles.one_line: Orange-framed map cover pinned to round medallions; folder-tab interiors with three scene bands.

formats.notes: C (default): 6-9 entries in 3 chapters, one tab each, up to 3 bands per tab page (e.g. skills by stage: plan / build / ship). A band is a caps name, a 'where it lives' line with a number verified on posting day (install source plus stars), and 'does X; replaces Y' in 20 words or fewer, keeping a three-band page inside the ~100-word structured budget. The concrete use goes on the deep-dive (the strongest entry), the combo on EXTRA. 7-8 slides: cover, deep-dive or why (8 with both), 3 tab pages, EXTRA, CTA. Spine C wants one item per slide and G1 counts slides, so every S18 C deck logs storyboard deviations[] '3 items per slide' and 'G1 count = bands, not slides' and checks G1 as pins = medallions = bands across the tab pages. Cover: the count in title line 2, the month or a verified star figure in the stamp. D (3-5 steps): one cover district, pin and medallion per step (that step's part); one tab per step plus an optional EXTRA; each step page is the deep-dive layout (one band with the step and what you build, the real panel in the capture zone, the prompt or command in a small ink card under it), so G1 holds as written. D length: cover, optional what/why, N step pages, optional day, CTA. What no other style has: persistent chapter tabs tying a pinned overview cover to each interior, three entries per page.

attributes.ground: Cover and CTA: a cream panel inset about 2.5% in a full-bleed Claude-orange ground, so the orange reads as a thin frame. Interiors: a cream top strip over three full-width painted scene bands at about 55% brightness. Each band deepens under a heavy gradient into a soft-edged flat ink pool behind its text
attributes.type_pairing: Chunky rounded display title (Nunito Black class) in cobalt with a pale sand sticker offset, plus an ink kicker pill. Interiors: Inter Black caps entry name, an Inter Bold pin line and an Inter Regular cream body, all as HTML cards
attributes.panel: Cover: an invented long, narrow sage island running diagonally, split into numbered districts, with orange pins and thin leader lines out to 6-9 ring medallions in two sizes. Interiors: 3 stacked bands per tab, the medallion alternating left/right/left and the text in a flat ink pool
attributes.character: None by default. The medallions are the collectibles, and every face is pasted from one set per deck: Codex-painted job emblems from a locked emblem sheet, or real logos on coloured face cards, never mixed. Optional: your own mascot (transparent PNG poses you made, never a licensed character) in an explorer pose holding a map on the cover, composited, never drawn
attributes.ornament: Folder-tab row (3-5 numbered tabs plus EXTRA) with the current tab lit orange and the counter at its right end; orange teardrop pins; notched ink medallion rims; an ochre compass-dial stamp beside title line 2; a cobalt 'start at tab 01' pill with three triangles
attributes.palette: Cream #F5EBE0 / Claude orange #D9551F / ink #0E0E0E / cobalt #3D7DC8 / sage #7DAA5A territory / ochre #E3A33B accents. Scenes use amber, ochre, deep green, slate #4A5560 and navy #2A3A55, never cobalt or teal

exemplars.note: Sample renders from the kit, no posted deck in this style yet: the kit's tab row, band cards and logo faces laid out on flat grounds. On a real deck the cover map and the interior scene bands are Codex-painted.

requires: HTML card kit engine/styles/kits/S18/ (README has the commands). cards/tabs-NN.html: one kit file whose data sets 3-5 numbered tabs, an optional EXTRA, the lit tab and the counter. Cobalt #3D7DC8 tabs with rounded top corners and 6 px cream gaps, the lit tab Claude orange #D9551F; Nunito 900 cream labels at 34 px or more, 8 characters or fewer with 3 tabs ('02 BUILD'), the number alone with 4-5; the 'NN / TT' counter in ink Inter 700 at 30 px or more at the right end. cards/band-NN.html, all text cream #F5EBE0: an Inter 900 caps name at 48 px (data-fit down to 40 px; names 14 characters or fewer), an orange pin plus an Inter 700 'where it lives' line at 30 px or more, an Inter 400 body at 30 px or more: 'does X; replaces Y' in 20 words or fewer, the concrete use in 22 on a deep-dive, what you build in 18 on a D step. In an emblem deck the card shows the entry's real mark as an beside the name. cards/face-NN.html (logo decks): the real mark at about 55% on a flat cobalt, ochre, sage or orange disc. Tabs and bands render with shared/render-card.mjs at each zone's --zones-only out bbox (2x), --bg sampled from the plate beside the zone; face cards with no --bg

No reference images ship with this style: Codex jobs run text-only (SYSTEM + the layout sub-block + KEYING) until the user approves a first plate; the locked cover and the locked first three-band page then become the references
Codex never receives a third-party slide, masked or not.

One face set per deck, made before the cover. Emblem deck: one locked emblem sheet (Codex, SYSTEM + EMBLEM SHEET), disc-cropped with a circular alpha into emblems/NN.png, via a shared/shots.py "discs": "auto" spec entry. Logo deck: faces/NN.png rendered from cards/face-NN.html. Every medallion face on every slide is pasted from this set through cyan, never repainted

Originality: never copy any reference deck's characters, art, words, hook, CTA phrasing, item set or signature palette; only the layout vocabulary carries over. Medallions carry Codex-painted job emblems or real logos; the map is an invented island

Real logos (your logo folder, simple-icons SVG or official marks): the subject mark for the cover's cyan slot, and each entry's mark (in its band card in an emblem deck, on its face card in a logo deck)
A verified 'where it lives' line per entry (install source plus stars, checked on posting day), and the cover stamp: the month or a verified star figure
One real capture (README, UI or terminal run) for the deep-dive page and each D step page; the exact prompt for the EXTRA card and the exact command for each D step
Spine C decks: storyboard.json deviations[] for '3 items per slide' and 'G1 count = bands, not slides'
A locked cover and a locked first three-band page, attached as reference #1 for every later slide so band heights, rims and pools stay fixed
Only if a cover label, numeral or stamp fails text QA: composite.py --paste cards/fix.png@x,y,w,h,erase to patch the string with a render-card label card. Never regenerate the cover

Optional mascot: your own explorer pose holding a map (a transparent PNG you made, never a licensed character), pasted through a cyan slot on the cover, never drawn by the model; with no mascot, no slot

styles.name: Window-Chrome Build Diary
styles.one_line: An app window as the frame, condensed white serif over real artboards, cut-outs breaking out over the chrome; apricot caption pages between.

formats.notes: Build diaries ('build your X in N steps', 'how I built X with Claude Code'). Spine D: cover → chrome cover, the N parts as painted icons breaking out of the grid; what/day → apricot result page; why → process row (old way raw → new way result); parts → parts row; step → stage slide, process row, command slide or cream zoom page; cta → CTA page. Spine A: what/use → result page; why → process row; model → parts row; how/start → stage slide; peak → command slide; cta → CTA page. Rhythm (storyboard only, never in a prompt): chrome slides and caption pages alternate, never two caption pages in a row, two chrome slides may run back to back for consecutive steps; the cover is chrome, the CTA a caption page. It is the one style that shows the work inside the tool's own window and has a raw-to-refined process row.

attributes.ground: Two grounds that alternate: a flat graphite canvas (#575757) inside a window frame (your own HTML window kit, or the subject app's real window), and flat apricot (#F5C9A0) / cream (#F5EBE0) caption pages

styles.name: Whiteboard Doodle Showcase
styles.one_line: Warm paper-white page: a handwritten item name over one orange marker underline, one real capture in a sketched ink frame, a handwritten caption, and a small ink doodle acting out what the item does.

formats.notes: C (default), 7-10 slides: cover, optional why, 5-8 item slides, optional combo (text panel), CTA. One item per slide: the exact name in the head card, one real capture (repo page or README with stars visible, UI or terminal run, checked on posting day), a caption of 34 words or fewer saying what it does in plain words, what it replaces and one concrete use, and a doodle acting out that job. The cover's index cards on a string equal the item count, so G1 can be checked by eye. A (explainer): the same item layout carries what, why, how, use and start; peak and start take an exact-text card in the frame, and the model slide an HTML diagram card. Not for head-to-heads (no side-by-side or table layout). What sets it apart: handwriting is the only typeface, every slide's doodle explains the item's job with objects rather than a character, one capture per slide and lots of empty paper.

styles.name: Icon-Grid Cheat Sheet
styles.one_line: Warm-white one-page cheat sheet: two real logo tiles joined by '+', a heavy count hook with one orange pill, then a numbered grid of N repo tiles (icon, name, one line, owner/repo).

formats.notes: One system, two formats. (1) One-pager: a single image (storyboard format "single", gates in engine/spines.md 'Format single'). The grid is the whole post and saves are the mechanic; N runs from 6 to 12, and the caption carries 'Comment KEYWORD' for the links. Tile text is save-and-zoom size (18 px lines), below the usual 1/40 floor. (2) Carousel, spine C. The same page is the cover: the count hook plus the full grid as a preview, with no comment ask. Then comes one item slide per tile, in cover order: the tile opened, with icon, name, what, one real capture, replaces, use, and owner/repo plus stars verified on posting day. An optional combo slide (N of 7 or fewer) and the CTA close it. N is 8 or fewer, so the deck stays at 10 slides or fewer, and G1 holds because every cover tile gets its own slide. Use it for repos, skills, plugins, MCP servers and apps. Not for head-to-heads, explainers or system builds: the grid has no slot for a verdict, a diagram or a step order.

attributes.ground: Flat warm white #FBF8F3; no grain, grid, gradient or texture
attributes.type_pairing: Heavy geometric grotesk (Inter Black), title case, tracking -0.03em for the centred hook, tile names and item headlines; Inter Regular warm-grey tile lines; cream Inter Bold badge numerals; JetBrains Mono for owner/repo, the month stamp and the NN / TT counter

Each tile has an orange number badge, a real app icon, the name, one to three warm-grey lines and an inset GitHub chip with owner/repo. Two real logo tiles joined by a heavy ink '+' crown the page. attributes.palette: #FBF8F3 warm white / #FFFFFF tiles / #0E0E0E ink / #5E574F and #6E675E warm greys / #E6DED3 borders / #F4EEE6 chips / #D9551F Claude orange (pill, badges, one accent word, label rules). Brand colour comes only from the real logos. The pill is solid orange, never a gradient and never pink (pink is a banned key-adjacent hue)

styles.name: Alpine Product Window
styles.one_line: One bright alpine wallpaper behind every interior: a real app-icon tile over a heavy product name, warm feature chips, one dark window holding a real capture and a three-cell icon footer; Claude-orange studio cover with real icons rising from a cream toolbox.

formats.notes: C first: N tools, skills, MCP servers, plugins or apps that each have a real UI or README to capture, one product page per item. Cover (studio, a toolbox of the items' real icons, count = item slides, month stamp in the corner label), optional why as a Before/after page, one Item page per item, optional Combo at n-1, CTA. Ten slides at most, so six items at most. Each Item page carries spine C's whole contract in about 45 words: the name as title, what it does in one 14-word line, README feature chips, a real capture as proof, and a footer with what it replaces, one concrete use and a posting-day proof figure. A: a single-tool deep dive in which every slide is a page of the same product, the subject's tile repeated, the title being the role's headline (7 words or fewer) and the window carrying that role's panel: what (chips preview the steps in plain words, no component names, G2), why as Before/after, model as an HTML diagram tagged explain, how and use as real captures, peak and start as exact-text mono. Not for B (no table or verdict vocabulary), D (no step-numbering device) or items with nothing to capture (prompts, concepts: use S21 or S27).

attributes.ground: Interiors: ONE photoreal alpine-valley plate reused on every interior: snow peaks in the side thirds framing a luminous hazy centre sky, pine slopes, a slate lake across the middle (mostly behind the window), a soft-focus white, yellow, cream and orange wildflower meadow with boulders, a blurred leafy branch top-left; HTML white veils behind the title band and the footer band. Cover and CTA: a seamless Claude-orange studio backdrop deepening to burnt sienna at the left and corners, one 3D cream toolbox as the hero
attributes.type_pairing: Inter 800 product-name titles, centred, ink, tracking -0.045em, over an Inter 500 two-line subtitle; Inter 500 chip and footer labels; JetBrains Mono window source label. Cover: giant Inter 900 numeral, Inter 800 caps noun line, one Caveat Brush script word over a hand-drawn underline, Inter 300 closing line, tracked Inter 600 caps corner labels. CTA: Anton caps "COMMENT" with the keyword in ink on a cream block. Every word is HTML
attributes.panel: One dark macOS-style window (#121418, traffic-light dots, mono source label in the bar) floating over the scenery at about 87% of the width and 43% of the height, its body ONE real capture; Before/after splits it into labelled without/with cells. Above it a real app-icon header tile (150 px) and a row of 3-5 warm-tint feature chips; below it a three-cell icon footer (replaces / use / proof)
attributes.character: None by default: the cover's actor is an unattended cream toolbox with the items' real icons composited into cyan slots rising out of it; the CTA shows it shut. Your own mascot (optional; transparent PNG poses you made, never a licensed character) only where a pose comments on the slide, composited as an , never painted
attributes.ornament: Tracked-caps corner labels with short cream rules on cover and CTA ({{BRAND}}, deck label and month, counter); Lucide line icons in chips, footer and CTA; 1 px rules between footer cells; an optional small Claude-orange four-point spark on glyph tiles; a "{{BRAND}} · NN / TT →" counter over a short ink rule
attributes.palette: Scene: sky #4A84C2 to #EEF3F8, pine #2F4A2E, slate lake #5E7B91, meadow greens, flowers white / #F2C230 / cream / orange. Cards: ink #0E0E0E, subtitle #2B2F36, window #121418, chips apricot #FBE3D6, butter #FFF1CC, sage #E2EDD9, sand #EFE5D8, stone #E9E7E3. Studio: #D9551F to #8F3414, cream #F5EBE0 type; Claude orange #D9551F as the one accent. Key-safe rules: water stays slate and the sky mid-blue, never green-blue (turquoise sits on the cyan key's hue); flowers are never pink (pink in an unkeyed plate trips composite.py's stray-magenta exit 3); chips stay warm, never lavender, pink or sky blue; UI accents are orange

exemplars.note: Sample renders from the kit: the cover page and an Item page over the kit's flat placeholder plates (labelled PLACEHOLDER PLATE; a real deck uses Codex plates), with YOUR BRAND in the chrome and placeholder captures in the window. No posted deck in this style yet.
